measuredOn: macOS 26.5.2 - arm64 - Xcode 26.2 - NLEmbedding sentence revision 1, dimension 512
rig: FocusNLProbe.app, bundle id com.chrismitchelmore.FocusNLProbe, LSBackgroundOnly, ad-hoc signed, launched only with `open -a ... --args <out.json>`. Every report recorded AXIsProcessTrusted() == false. Two launches produced byte-identical output and an identical FNV-1a of 0xc314a5d02e6dfd7d over all 62 pairs' concatenated little-endian vector components; the same run from a plain CLI produced the identical digest.
note: The raw table, committed so a later epic re-derives rather than re-trusts (R-74.2). P-113's sixteen pairs were too few to fix a float on: one additional unrelated pair below the drafted 1.00 ceiling would have falsified its whole justification, and this table has four of them. 62 pairs, 30 related and 32 unrelated, drawn from ten realistic priorities with three plausible on-task evidence titles and three plausible distractions each. The labels were written before any distance was computed.
distanceRule: The Euclidean distance between the two L2-normalised sentence vectors, i.e. sqrt(2 * (1 - cosine)). Measured identical to NLEmbedding.distance(between:and:distanceType:.cosine) to 1.03e-6 on every pair, which is what lets the engine cache one vector per priority revision (R-65) and still land on the number P-113 measured through the framework call.
derivation: similarityRelevantCeiling = the measured unrelated MINIMUM, minus one population standard deviation of the unrelated class, rounded DOWN to two decimals. Rounding down costs misses rather than false positives, which is the direction this whole engine leans (R-58, R-74.2).
